current.text: Julius Randle and Naz Reid are gone from Minnesota. The Wolves traded for LaMelo Ball and moved to a smaller, guard-heavy lineup.
Minnesota signed Jonathan Kuminga and added Ayo Dosunmu for a full season.
Most experts expect his usage, shots and rebounds to go up with Randle and Reid gone. One expert doubts he reaches 20 percent usage because Kuminga will take shots.
Kuminga dims his upside a little, but he should keep his starting spot and still beat his draft position.
He is a projected starter next to Ball, Edwards and Gobert. Coach Chris Finch said he will play some power forward but probably will not start there or play all his minutes there.
He has been sliding in a lot of drafts.
Experts see him as value at a rank in the 90s and would take him in the 70s. One expert called a rank of 74 about right.
He went for 11 USD in an expert mock auction. A 25 USD price seen in another auction was called an overpay.
He has upside for a usage spike if a teammate misses time. Minnesota's frontcourt and bench depth are very thin.
With a March 28 end, Minnesota plays 4, 2 and 4 games in the fantasy playoff weeks, so the semifinal week (starting March 15) has only two games. The team has the league minimum of 13 back-to-backs.
Minnesota should be competitive and is not expected to rest players for tanking. One expert predicts 53 wins.

durable.text: He has a steals and blocks profile, with about a steal and a block per game. His blocks are strong for a forward.
He is worth more in category leagues than in points leagues.
His usage has gone up in each of the last three seasons.
He has no weak category in the projections, so he fits any build.

note: Jaden McDaniels is cheap: Yahoo values him at 11 USD with an average cost of 2 USD, ESPN at 4 USD, and he went for 1 USD in our league last season. Experts would take him in the 70s, so a bid in the high single digits to about 11 USD is fair value, and 25 USD is too much. His projected 1.1 steals, 1.0 blocks and 50.9% FG fit any build. Early in the season, check how many shots and minutes Kuminga takes from him and whether he plays power forward. Plan around Minnesota's two-game semifinal week.
